page.layout: Two columns of Hebrew lexicon entries, separated by a vertical rule. Left column: Rad. heading line and entries down to "eum,". Right column: from "fut. Hiph." down to "Hiph." at the foot. No margin notes. Running heads at the top left and top right are Hebrew letter marks.

main_text.p: וְיֶרֶק & olus, sing. m. constr. No. יֶרֶק olus, Rad. יָרַק spuit.
וּכְיֶרֶק & sicut viriditas, No. f. m. praef. R. יֶרֶק.
יָרַק spuere, Infin. Kal, Rad. יָרַק.
וַיָּרֶק & evacuavit (pro יָרַק, vel יָרִיק,) fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. יוּק, vel יָרִיק.
יִרְקוֹן rubigo, בִּירַקְרַק in subviridi, יִרְקְרַקּוֹת subviridես, (à f. fæm. יִרְקְרַקָּת,) No. f m praef. & pl. fæm. gem. R. יָרַק.
וַיִּירַשׁ & hæreditate accipiet, יִירְשׁוּהָ et hæreditate acceperunt eam, pro יִירְשׁוּ, & יִרְשׁוּ, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. & 3. pl. m. aff. R. יָרַשׁ.
וַיִּירַשׁ et hæredem instituit, it, וַיִּירְשָׁם eos, יִרְשָׁהוּ hæredem instituit eum,
יִרְשׁוּ fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. R. יָרַשׁ.
יָרְשָׁהּ posside, Imper. Kal, parag. pro יָרַשׁ.
וִירִשְׁוּהָ & hæreditate acceperunt eam, pret. Kal, 3. pl. aff. Rad. יָרַשׁ.
הַלְּיִירְשָׁנוּ an possidendo nos, Infin. Kal, praef. aff. Rad. יָרַשׁ.
וִירְשָׁנוּךָ & hæreditate accepimus te, pret. Kal, 1. pl. aff. Rad. יָרַשׁ.
מִיִּרְשָׁתְךָ ex hæreditate tua, sing. fæm. praef. aff. No. יְרֻשָּׁה; Rad. יָרַשׁ.
וִירִשְׁתָּם & hæreditate accepistis, וִירִשְׁתָּה et hæreditate accepisti eam, ם eos, pret. Kal, 2. pl. m. & 2. f. m. aff. Rad. יָרַשׁ.
יִרְשָׁתָּם hæreditate accepisti eos, pro יִרְשָׁתָּם. pret. Kal, 2. f. m. aff. R. יָרַשׁ.

page.notes: Hebrew forms are copied from the scan at low resolution; several vowel points and letters are uncertain and are not marked individually. Page number read as 196 with doubt. The left-column entry "et hæredem instituit" continues into "it" on the next line and is joined into one paragraph. Right-column top line "fut. Hiph." is the continuation of the entry above it. Abbreviation "Rad." and "R." kept as printed.
